summary: Iteration 6 — frontend-only aggressive stress re-verification of the recurring 'removeChild / NotFoundError' crash after removing React.StrictMode and setting isAnimationActive={false} on all Recharts series. Logged in as admin. Executed: (A) 5 full loops x 6 tabs at 120-200ms click interval (forcing mid-fetch unmounts) each loop mixed with a site change followed by 3 more fast tab clicks inside the 200ms selectSite deferral window; (B) Dashboard-focused stress: 3 rounds x 4 sites rapid site switching while LineChart+BarChart were still rendering; (C) 6x site change -> tab change 60ms later (inside deferral window); (D) EXTREME round: 4 loops x 6 tabs at 60-90ms interval, 10x browser back + 10x forward history spam, and 3x hard reload of /dashboard with a site change 300ms after mount (charts mid-render) followed by an immediate tab change. pageerror + console-error listeners active in every run. RESULT: ZERO uncaught exceptions, ZERO NotFoundError / removeChild / insertBefore, ZERO console errors across all runs. Regressions all pass: 6 tabs render correct headings, Bournezeau Dashboard renders 2 line curves (pH + AGV/TAC) and 4 bars (Mécanique/Process), empty sites (Celles sur Belle, Villefollet) render empty chart frames without crashing, user dropdown opens and the site-selector now opens on the FIRST click while the dropdown is open (modal={false} confirmed), Maintenance create -> complete -> delete full flow works (toasts 'Intervention enregistrée' / 'Supprimé'), empty site shows amber no-equip-warning with save-task disabled, and logout -> re-login cycle works with no setState-after-unmount warning.

rca_of_the_issue: Prior removeChild NotFoundError cascade had two dev-environment culprits: (1) React.StrictMode double-mount racing with Radix portals and Recharts D3 mutations, and (2) Recharts D3 animations detaching nodes React still tracked when Dashboard unmounted mid-animation. Both are now neutralised (StrictMode removed in index.js, isAnimationActive={false} on all Line/Bar). Verified unreproducible under 60-200ms tab cycling, mid-render site switches, and history spam.
